textSegments: Complies with ATX12V V3.1 / Flex ATX V2.1 (650W)
Complies with ATX12V V2.52 / Flex ATX V1.23 (500W)
Compliant with UL/EN/IEC international safety standards
Efficiency ≧ 90% at typical load(650W≧ 92% at typical load)
Quiet and long-lasting 40mm ball bearing fan
Black cables for the need of enthusiasts
Complete protections: UVP, OVP, SCP, OPP, OTP, SIP, NLO (650W)
Complete protections: UVP, OVP, SCP, OPP, OTP (500W)
The FlexGURU PRO series offers an inner 40mm fan design, which reduces noise and allows for maximum cooling at all times.
The all black round cables offers your system a more sophisticated look compared to other entry-level power supplies.

The efficiency of your power supply is very important since it directly affects your system's performance. The FlexGURU PRO 500W has a guaranteed typical efficiency of 90% and offers a high conversion power to power your system.
The FlexGURU PRO series comes with the included 1U bracket which turns the FlexGURU PRO 500W into a 1U IPC power supply.

FSP Group features the latest in green power technology and provides additional safety approvals to keep its power supplies ahead of regulation changes. FSP has upgraded the majority of its power supplies to the newer IEC 62368 standards.

OVP (Over Voltage Protection), UVP (Under Voltage Protection), OPP (Over Power Protection), SCP (Short Circuit Protection), and OTP (Over Temperature Protection), full guardian circuit protection to keep your hardware safe.
The FlexGURU PRO series utilizes main Japanese Electrolytic Capacitors to offer stable outputs and long-term reliability.
